comment: Inputs that have found a crash. Every one of these runs on every fuzz run, forever, the same way a corpus variant does. A case is a seed plus the variant and operator that seed selected: recording those two explicitly is what keeps a case reproducing the same bytes after the corpus grows.

cases.name: corrupt-deflate-payload
cases.found: zlib.error / TypeError escaped from the inflater; a corrupt payload is a malformed file, not the codec library's exception type

cases.name: string-field-that-is-not-utf8
cases.found: UnicodeDecodeError escaped from a string field

cases.name: sh-band-element-count-mismatch
cases.found: ValueError from reshaping a band stream whose element count disagreed with its chunk

cases.name: corrupt-zstd-payload
cases.found: ZstdError escaped when a corrupted codec byte selected zstd

cases.name: attribute-stream-with-no-columns
cases.found: IndexError from a stream that decoded to zero channels

cases.name: index-entry-pointing-outside-the-file
cases.found: ValueError / RangeError from the transport when a record's declared range left the file

cases.name: footer-summary-past-the-footer
cases.found: ValueError from a negative read length; the bug that made validate() crash on the file it exists to diagnose

cases.name: rotation-index-outside-0-3
cases.found: IndexError from a rotation index naming a component that does not exist

cases.name: cutoff-outside-0-1
cases.found: math domain error from log(cutoff) when a corrupt header declared a threshold of zero

cases.name: constant-stream-expansion-bomb
cases.found: 1.4 seconds and gigabytes of allocation from one flipped bit: a constant stream declaring 2^30 elements expands a one-byte payload, which the payload-size cap never saw
